item.description:
This page is the map for the data science and quantum computing articles. Pick one goal below. The full archive stays at All Data Science posts.

If you are learning quantum computing
#

Start with the word, then the hardware, then a career map.

  1. A Mental Map of Quantum Mechanics Vocabulary — system, state, observable, operator, measurement
  2. What Is Error in Quantum Computing? — damage to the state, mitigation, and error correction
  3. Quantum Hardware Is Not a Smaller Classical Computer — why a qubit is not a transistor
  4. Quantum Computing Careers — where a software professional should enter
  5. Learning Quantum Physics series — math and the rest, in order

If you want to run LLMs locally
#

A practical sequence: install Ollama, then optional setup on WSL2 or Docker.
